_help: Edit directions freely. x and y are the marker position on the plan as a percentage of image width and height (0-100). Use null for rooms that are not on the plan. Rooms appear in this order across the timetable grid.

plan.alt: Isometric floor plan of Church House showing the first floor, ground floor and lower ground floor

info.title: Great Smith Street entrance
info.text: Main entrance to Reception on the ground floor, including disabled access.

info.title: Dean's Yard entrance
info.text: Ground-floor entrance on the left of the plan, with its own Reception.

info.title: Lifts and stairs
info.text: Lifts serve all three floors. The main lifts are beside ground-floor Reception; stairs are in the middle of the ground floor.

info.title: Coffee and snacks
info.text: Ground floor near Reception, in Church House Café (entrance on the right-hand side), and at a coffee point in Bishop Partridge Hall on the first floor.

info.title: Cloakroom
info.text: Lower ground floor, near the lifts.

info.title: Accessible toilets
info.text: Marked on each floor of the plan: first floor near the stairs and lifts, and lower ground floor by the cloakroom.

rooms.name: Assembly Hall
rooms.directions: Take the lifts or stairs from ground-floor Reception up to the First floor. Assembly Hall is the big oval hall in the middle of the floor.

rooms.name: Hoare Memorial Hall
rooms.directions: First floor. From the stairs and lifts, head to the right-hand side of the floor, past Assembly Hall.

rooms.name: Convocation Hall
rooms.directions: First floor, on the far side of the floor behind Assembly Hall, next to the Bishops' Robing Room.

rooms.name: Chapel
rooms.directions: First floor, on the left-hand side of the floor, below the Bishops' Robing Room.

rooms.name: Bishop Partridge Hall
rooms.directions: First floor, just to the left of the stairs and lifts. There is a coffee point inside.

rooms.name: Council Room
rooms.directions: Ground floor. Come in by the Great Smith Street entrance: the Council Room is just past Reception, at the end of the corridor.

rooms.name: Westminster Room
rooms.directions: Ground floor, far left of the floor. Come in by the Dean's Yard entrance, pass Reception and keep left. It is next to the Abbey Room.

rooms.name: Abbey Room
rooms.directions: Ground floor, left side of the floor, just beyond Reception from the Dean's Yard entrance. It sits next to the Westminster Room.

rooms.name: Church House Café
rooms.directions: Ground floor, right-hand side. Walk past the stairs and the Harvey Goodwin Suite. The café has its own entrance from outside.

rooms.name: Harvey Goodwin Suite
rooms.directions: Ground floor, right-hand side, between the stairs and the South Door (exit only).

rooms.name: Robert Runcie Room
rooms.directions: Take the lifts down to the Lower ground floor. The room is straight ahead of the lifts, at the top right of the floor.

rooms.name: Hospitality Suite
rooms.directions: Lower ground floor. From the lifts, turn left past the cloakroom. The suite is the large room at the front of the floor.

rooms.name: Temple Room
rooms.directions: Lower ground floor, at the far right-hand side, beyond the Hospitality Suite.

rooms.name: Parker Morris Hall
rooms.directions: The Abbey Centre is a separate building from Church House. First floor. EDIT ME: add walking directions from Church House.

rooms.name: Wash House Café
rooms.directions: The Abbey Centre is a separate building from Church House. Ground floor. EDIT ME: add walking directions from Church House.

rooms.name: Location TBC
rooms.directions: The programme does not give a room for this event. See page 12 of the printed programme.
